program.name: Strike & Lift
program.subject: Fighter
program.blurb: Boxing or kickboxing bouts, then dumbbell and kettlebell strength for the muscles you just used.
program.about: Striking first, then lifting to back it up. Punch days pair boxing bouts with presses and rows, kick days pair kickboxing bouts with squats, hinges and lunges, and the third day mixes both styles and ends with a mobility flow. Dumbbells or a kettlebell are all you need. Level II moves you one weight up and Level III adds reps, the bouts bring longer combinations and every hold in the flow gets longer. Strength days end with abs.
program.split: Punch & press / kick & squat / bouts & reset
program.gear: A pair of dumbbells or a kettlebell.
